# Priscilla Grant & Stella Maynard

- [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) — Friend of — [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) — former school chums at Queen's Academy · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming close friendships and continuing her quiet academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She visits [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and stays focused as the term progresses toward final examinations. As spring arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her classmates anxiously discuss their upcoming tests and future prospects.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her second term at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while dealing with an unwanted marriage proposal from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) writes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) suggesting they rent a house together in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) for the upcoming school year with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as their housekeeper. After searching in vain for a suitable house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) spot a 'To Let' sign on Patty's Place.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends return to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) for their Sophomore year and settle comfortably into [Patty’s Place](../codex/places.md#patty-s-place). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is unexpectedly adopted by a stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), the girls fail to humane-euthanize him, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to keep him. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperone the household, bringing along her own cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the Sarah-cat.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on turning twenty while talking with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) in the living room. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) comes downstairs dressed for a dance, prompting a lighthearted conversation about beauty, marriage, and potential suitors before she departs. After [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) leaves, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a brief moment reflecting on Phil's eccentric personality.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIX An Interlude

> As April examinations approach, the girls at Patty's Place prepare for their studies and learn that Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) will remain abroad for another year. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a evening walk in the park, where she joyfully reveals that she has accepted [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) Blake's marriage proposal. As they discuss Phil's future as a minister's wife in the slums, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her ideal romance with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) and her lingering thoughts of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

> The girls return to Patty's Place for their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), chatting and laughing with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as they unpack. Later in the semester, during a rainy evening, [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares melodramatic stories written during her school days in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives good news when her short story is accepted for publication, which raises her literary spirits. Later, while out on a walk with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns his family plans to visit. However, Roy's mother and sisters arrive a day early on Friday, surprising the household and causing a flustered, humorous interaction before Roy's friendly sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) connects warmly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

> As their final examinations come to an end, the girls and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) reflect on what their four years at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) have taught them. For [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) and the graduation dance, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's gifted lilies-of-the-valley and pink enamel heart pendant instead of Roy's violets. However, after [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) mentions a rumor about Gilbert's engagement to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), a hurt [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) snaps the necklace, turns [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) down for a dance, and masks her heartbreak during the night's festivities.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s
